## AI report → tracked link
Every Monday an AI agent writes the weekly ops report, a Code node renders it to a PDF (no dependencies), and EveryPage turns it into a **tracked share link** — so you know whether anyone actually read what the agent produced.

Swap the Slack step for email, Teams, or your CRM. Add `requireEmail: true` in the EveryPage node's options to gate the report (Pro).

parameters.text: Write this week's operations report for the team: a short executive summary, then sections for shipped work, metrics, risks, and next week's focus. Plain text, no markdown syntax. Around 500 words.

=📄 This week's report is live: {{ $json.shareUrl }}
EveryPage will tell us who actually reads it.
